jobs.description: 토지소유 kind Gold (root ADR-0361; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-ownership): gold.parcel_ownership from silver.land_ownership, when the Silver lane or the served parcel edition moved past the pins the current Gold recorded. It recomputes only the PNUs of the owner rows the Silver release appended (and of parcels that entered or left the served edition) and merges them; a change of the code change table rebuilds whole (land_ownership_silver_to_gold.WHOLE_TABLE_INPUTS). Its own job because an own-producer kind is never a table of `kinds` (root ADR-0287 §9). by_pnu_serving_bake bakes its commit.

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never run as its unit in the journal (2026-10-16 to 2026-11-03); enabling it needs an attended run measured first (root ADR-0386 §3).

jobs.disabled_reason: New (root ADR-0361). Off until its first full build (about 120 million owner rows nationally, computed) has run attended and been timed within the unit's 150-minute limit (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh gold rebuild parcel-ownership, root ADR-0193 §7), after silver_refresh_land_ownership loaded its first release; switching it on is a separate deploy step (ADR-0122 §4).

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_ownership (the own-producer ownership kind, root ADR-0361) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-ownership), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9): a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation, exactly as the panel bake does per lane. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2): a slow national parcel re-bake in by_pnu_serving_bake never holds it. Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_ownership_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 10:55 as the fallback (root ADR-0171); each run's containers are its own one-offs (tools/semgrep/rules/batch-containers.yml). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the public-auction bake's bound: a scheduled run patches the parcels a twice-yearly release changed, and the lane's whole generation is the operator's cut-over bake (root ADR-0190), not this job's. Two slots so it never runs beside both the panel bake and the public-auction bake: the three at once (14 + 5 + 5 = 24g) would exceed the host budget's 22g job allowance (root ADR-0138).

per_run_cap.unmeasured_reason: Not enabled and never run as its unit in the journal (2026-10-16 to 2026-11-03); enabling it needs an attended run measured first (root ADR-0386 §3).

jobs.disabled_reason: New (root ADR-0361). Off with gold_parcel_ownership_rebuild, which feeds it: nothing to bake until that job's first full build is timed and the operator has cut the lane over (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-ownership cutover 1, root ADR-0190); switching both on is one separate deploy step (ADR-0122 §4).

assets.title: 필지 토지소유 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지의 공유인(소유구분·거주지구분·국가기관구분·소유권변동원인·변동일자·공유인수, 100명까지)과 전체 수, 집합건물 호 소유자는 소유구분별 수만 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0361). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-ownership)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, 필지 패널이 아니라 silver.land_ownership 에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다.

assets.title: 필지 토지소유 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_ownership 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/ownership/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0361). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287 9항, ADR-0361): 필지의 현재 소유 행을 서빙 필지판의 PNU에만 문서로 묶는다. Silver 가 덧붙인 행의 PNU와 필지판에 들고 난 PNU만 다시 계산한다.
개편으로 바뀐 코드에 걸린 소유 행을 서빙 필지판의 코드로 읽는다(모든 필지 섹션과 같은 renumbered). 이 표가 바뀌면 종류를 통째로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0361).
